name: GPU Helper
description: iOS Metal visibility compute with opt-in atlas-quad culling, texture-atlas recovery, and extended persistent crash diagnostics.

debug-overlay.name: Show in-game GPU diagnostics overlay
debug-overlay.description: Show the large live diagnostic HUD with a 4 Hz changing update counter, per-level scan breakdown, driver heartbeats, Metal submit/completion counts, visibility results, GPU timing, and persistent crash-trace status.

graphics-mode.name: GPU Helper graphics path
graphics-mode.description: Legacy keeps the previous diagnostic-only Metal visibility measurement. GPU-driven classifies actual CCTextureAtlas quad bounds with Metal and consumes the resulting visibility mask at CCTextureAtlas::drawNumberOfQuads by issuing ordered visible ranges. Dynamic quads remain visible; atlas structural changes, transform changes, and stale view results fail open. Default is legacy.

gpu-decoration-culling.name: GPU static-decoration visibility measurement (safe mode)
gpu-decoration-culling.description: Enable Metal visibility processing. In Legacy mode, only old decoration bounds are measured. In GPU-driven mode, cached atlas quad bounds are tested and valid masks split the real atlas draw into contiguous visible runs. Moving quads stay visible and unsafe atlas states fall back to the normal draw.
